programs.name: Bachelor of Information Technology
programs.a_level_offer: Aggregate of 8 from the best three GCE A-level subjects (A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1); at least two subjects in the same academic year, the third from the preceding or following year. GCE AS-levels are not accepted for bachelor entry.
programs.ap_offer: US high school diploma plus at least one of: SAT 1120, ACT 21, cumulative GPA 2.7 (4.0 scale) or 80% overall average; or an AP score of 6 (sum of the best 2 AP subjects, each graded 3 or above). SAT, ACT and AP are considered only together with evidence of successful completion of an accepted US senior high school qualification. AP subjects may also earn credit towards first-year study.
programs.required_subjects: None. Recommended: HSC Mathematics Extension 1 or 2 plus HSC Information Processes and Technology and/or Software Design and Development, or equivalent.
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT, scores from 1 March 2026: old 0-120 scale overall 86 (reading 18, writing 20, listening 17, speaking 20); new 1-6 scale overall 4.5 (4.0 in each skill).
programs.english_note: Macquarie 'Competent' level of English, which applies to most undergraduate courses. Also accepted: PTE Academic 60 (51 reading, 55 writing, 50 listening, 54 speaking) and Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency 180 (169 in each skill), from 1 March 2026.
programs.notes: International selection rank 75 (2027 entry); the page says it is based on the ATAR system and that overseas results are converted to it. Fee: estimated annual international fee AUD $48,900 for 2027, full-time (A$611.25 per credit point). Starts: Session 1 (22 February 2027) or Session 2 (26 July 2027) at North Ryde; applications for Session 1 close 8 February 2027 (the closing date may vary by region). Australian Year 12 students apply through UAC (UAC code 300540). A-level, SAT, ACT, AP and GPA values come from the course page's international qualification converter. IB value: Macquarie's 'Academic Entry for International Students (Undergraduate)' PDF dated July 2026, row 'B Information Technology': https://www.mq.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0003/1381269/Academic-Entry-for-International-Students-Undergraduate-July-2026.pdf . Admission pathways exist through Macquarie University College for applicants below the rank. This is Macquarie's main IT degree (majors include Software Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security and Data Science); there is no separate Computer Science bachelor's listing.
